name: Mankitsu Koshitsu de Lolicon to ~Shoujo no Hiketsu o Chou Mankitsu!!~
original_name: マン喫個室でロリコンと～少女の秘穴を超マンキツ!!～
source:
Precocious little Akane and meet in the private room of a manga cafe. 
Your aim, of course, is her body. 
Arousal expands greatly in such a tight, cramped space. 
Touching, fooling, loving, menacing. 
The absolutely joy of young velvet cunny!! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063655.html]DLsite English[/url]]

你在漫畫咖啡廳的包廂裡遇見了早熟的小茜。
你的目標當然是她的身體。

觸摸、戲弄、愛撫、威脅。
盡情享受少女柔軟肌膚帶來的絕對快樂吧！
